title: 華嚴經・諸菩薩住處品
intro: 八十華嚴〈諸菩薩住處品〉＝六十華嚴〈菩薩住處品〉＝藏譯第 38 品。心王菩薩列舉十方與諸國的菩薩住處，其中「東北方清涼山，文殊師利與一萬菩薩常住說法」即五台山信仰的經典依據；震旦國那羅延窟亦在其中。六十華嚴把曇無竭（法起）的四大海中住處排在西北方之後（⇅）；巴連弗邑（華氏城）一處八十華嚴無。藏譯把文殊住處記為東方，地名多意譯。

諸菩薩住處品第三十二

zc-01.T0278: 爾時，心王菩薩摩訶薩復告諸菩薩言：「佛子！東方有菩薩住處，名仙人起山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名金剛勝，於其中止，有三百菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-01.T0279: 爾時，心王菩薩摩訶薩於眾會中告諸菩薩言：「佛子！東方有處，名：仙人山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名：金剛勝，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾三百人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-01.en: Chapter on the Dwellings of Bodhisattvas  Then the bodhisattva King of Mind spoke again to those bodhisattvas, “O children of the Victorious One! In the east, there is a mountain called Appearance of a Sage, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Vajraśrī teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of three hundred bodhisattvas. “

zc-02.T0278: 南方有菩薩住處，名勝樓閣山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名法慧，有五百菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-02.T0279: 南方有處，名：勝峯山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名曰：法慧，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾五百人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-02.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the south, there is a mountain called Heap of Glory, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Dharmamati teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of five hundred bodhisattvas. “

zc-03.T0278: 西方有菩薩住處，名金剛焰山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名無畏師子行，有三百菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-03.T0279: 西方有處，名：金剛焰山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名：精進無畏行，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾三百人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-03.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the west, there is a mountain called Possessed of Vajra Radiance, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Walks with the Gait of a Lion teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of three hundred bodhisattvas. “

zc-04.T0278: 北方有菩薩住處，名香聚山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名香象，有三千菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-04.T0279: 北方有處，名：香積山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名曰：香象，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾三千人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-04.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the north, there is a mountain called Heap of Incense, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Gandhahastin teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of three thousand bodhisattvas. “

zc-05.T0278: 東北方有菩薩住處，名清涼山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名文殊師利，有一萬菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-05.T0279: 東北方有處，名：清涼山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名：文殊師利，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾一萬人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-05.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the east, there is a mountain called Mountain of Meadows,  where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Mañjuśrī teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of ten thousand bodhisattvas. “

zc-06.T0278: 四大海中有菩薩住處，名枳怛，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名曇無竭，有萬二千菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-06.T0279: 海中有處，名：金剛山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名曰：法起，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾千二百人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-06.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the northeastern direction, there is a mountain called Vajra Mountain, Site of Four Great Oceans, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Dharmodgata teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of twelve hundred bodhisattvas. “

zc-07.T0278: 東南方有菩薩住處，名枝堅固，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名天冠，有一千菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-07.T0279: 東南方有處，名：支提山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名曰：天冠，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾一千人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-07.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the southeastern direction, there is a mountain called Stūpa, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Divine Aggregates teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of one thousand bodhisattvas. “

zc-08.T0278: 西南方有菩薩住處，名樹提光明山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名賢首，有三千菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-08.T0279: 西南方有處，名：光明山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名曰：賢勝，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾三千人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-08.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the southwestern direction, there is a mountain called Jyotiṣprabha, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Bhadraśrī teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of three thousand bodhisattvas. “

zc-09.T0278: 西北方有菩薩住處，名香風山，過去諸菩薩常於中住；彼現有菩薩，名香光明，有五千菩薩眷屬，常為說法。
zc-09.T0279: 西北方有處，名：香風山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住；現有菩薩，名曰：香光，與其眷屬、諸菩薩眾五千人俱，常在其中而演說法。
zc-09.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the northwestern direction, there is a mountain called Gandhamādana, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. In this dwelling place a bodhisattva called Radiating Luminous Incense teaches Dharma surrounded by a retinue of five thousand bodhisattvas. “

zc-10.T0278: 海中有菩薩住處，名功德莊嚴窟，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-10.T0279: 「大海之中復有住處，名：莊嚴窟，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-10.en: O children of the Victorious One! In the great ocean, there is a place called Good Cave, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-11.T0278: 毘舍離城南有菩薩住處，名善住，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-11.T0279: 毘舍離南有一住處，名：善住根，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-11.en: O children of the Victorious One! To the south of Vaiśālī, there is a place called Stable Roots, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-12.T0278: 巴連弗邑有菩薩住處，名金燈僧伽藍，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-12.en: In a land called Pāṭaliputra, there is a place called Golden Park of the Saṅgha, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-13.T0278: 摩瑜羅國有菩薩住處，名長養功德，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-13.T0279: 摩度羅城有一住處，名：滿足窟，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-13.en: In a land called Mathurā,  there is a place called Satisfying Cave, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-14.T0278: 拘陳那耶國有菩薩住處，名法座，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-14.T0279: 俱珍那城有一住處，名曰：法座，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-14.en: In a land called Relinquishing the Vase, there is a place called Dharma Seat, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-15.T0278: 清淨彼岸國有菩薩住處，名牟真隣陀功德，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-15.T0279: 清淨彼岸城有一住處，名：目真隣陀窟，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-15.en: In a land called Perfect Virtue, there is a place called Mucilinda Cave, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-16.T0278: 風地內有菩薩住處，名無礙龍王所造，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-16.T0279: 摩蘭陀國有一住處，名：無礙龍王建立，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-16.en: In a land called Vatsa, there is a place, established by nāgas, called Añcala, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-17.T0278: 甘菩國有菩薩住處，名最上慈，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-17.T0279: 甘菩遮國有一住處，名：出生慈，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-17.en: In a land called Kamboja, there is a place called Exalted by Love, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-18.T0278: 真旦國土有菩薩住處，名那羅延山，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-18.T0279: 震旦國有一住處，名：那羅延窟，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-18.en: In a land called China, there is a place called Nārāyaṇa Cave, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-19.T0278: 邊夷國土有菩薩住處，名牛頭山，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-19.T0279: 䟽勒國有一住處，名：牛頭山，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-19.en: In a land called Khaśa, there is a mountain called Gośṛṇga, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-20.T0278: 罽賓國土有菩薩住處，名鬱提尸山，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-20.T0279: 迦葉彌羅國有一住處，名曰：次第，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-20.en: In a land called Kashmir, there is a place called Sudarśaka, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-21.T0278: 難提拔檀那城有菩薩住處，名梯羅浮訶，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-21.T0279: 增長歡喜城有一住處，名：尊者窟，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-21.en: In a land called Increasing Joy, there is a place called Sthavira Cave, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-22.T0278: 菴浮梨摩國有菩薩住處，名正治邪曲，過去諸菩薩常於中住。
zc-22.T0279: 菴浮梨摩國有一住處，名：見億藏光明，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。
zc-22.en: In a land called Jalandhar, there is a place called Teaching with Hands Folded, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided. “

zc-23.T0278: 乾陀羅國有菩薩住處，名寂靜窟，過去諸菩薩常於中住。」
zc-23.T0279: 乾陀羅國有一住處，名：苫婆羅窟，從昔已來，諸菩薩眾於中止住。」
zc-23.en: In the vicinity of the land called Gandhara, there is a place called Cave of Provisions, where bodhisattvas in the past have resided.”

zc-24.en: This concludes “The Dwellings of Bodhisattvas,” the thirty-eighth chapter of the extensive sūtra, “The Ornaments of the Buddhas.”
